title: A 2x Taiwan 50 from the start of the midterm year to the election edged holding 0050 in 2014–2026 (22.8% vs 21.3%, 3 windows) with a −58% drawdown against −34%; from the midterm itself it trailed; half capital in 2x matches 1x
strategy: 2x Taiwan 50 from the midterm year to the election
question: Does holding a 2x Taiwan 50 product (00631L) from the midterm year to the presidential election raise capital efficiency, and at what drawdown?
hypothesis: Concentrating exposure in the cycle's strong stretch with 2x leverage beats holding 1x all the time.

findings.title: About level with holding 0050, with 1.7 times the drawdown
findings.detail: 2014–2026, 0050 base, 3 windows: 2x from the start of the midterm year to the election 22.77% CAGR, max drawdown −58.41%, invested 72.7% of the time; 2x from the midterm itself 17.22%, −49.52%; 0050 held throughout 21.26%, −33.83%. Not resolvable with 3 windows.
findings.title_zh: 和一直抱 0050 差不多，回檔 1.7 倍

findings.title: Half capital in 2x ≈ full capital in 1x
findings.detail: Inside the same windows: 12.35% / −34.32% against 13.09% / −33.83%. The freed half must earn more than the ~0.7-point gap for this to help.
findings.title_zh: 半數資金買正二 ≈ 全部買 1 倍
findings.detail_zh: 同樣窗口：12.35%／−34.32% 對 13.09%／−33.83%。省下的一半資金要賺超過約 0.7 個百分點才划算。

findings.title: On TAIEX since 2001 the 2x lost in most windows
findings.detail: 4 of 6 Y2-start windows negative, worst in-window drawdown −82.61% (2006–2008); pessimistic because the price index lacks dividends.
findings.title_zh: 加權 2001 年起：多數窗口正二是虧的
findings.detail_zh: 6 個期中選舉年初起的窗口有 4 個虧損，窗口內最深回檔 −82.61%（2006–2008）；加權不含股息，結果偏悲觀。

card_summary: Holding a 2x Taiwan 50 from the start of the midterm year to the election earned 22.8% a year on 0050 data (2014–2026, 3 windows) against 21.3% for holding 0050 throughout, with a −58% drawdown against −34%; starting at the midterm itself gave 17.2%. Half the capital in 2x reproduces 1x exposure; leverage frees capital, it does not lower risk.
title_zh: 期中選舉年初到大選持有正二：2014–2026 年和一直抱 0050 差不多（22.8% 對 21.3%，3 輪），回檔 −58% 對 −34%；從期中選舉當天才買則落後；半數資金買正二約等於 1 倍
question_zh: 期中選舉年買正二、大選後出場，能不能提高資金效率，報酬和回檔跟一直抱 0050 比如何？
hypothesis_zh: 把槓桿集中在歷史上較強的期間，可以用較少的時間賺到更多。
card_summary_zh: 0050 資料（2014–2026，3 輪）：期中選舉年初到大選持有正二，年化 22.8%，一直抱 0050 為 21.3%，但最大回檔 −58% 對 −34%；從期中選舉當天才買為 17.2%。半數資金買正二只是重現 1 倍曝險：槓桿省下資金，不降低風險。
limitations_zh: 0050 只有 3 個完整窗口；加權 6 個，但不含股息。
合成正二 = 2 × 日報酬 − 年 2.0%，比真實 00631L 略樂觀。
interpretation_zh: 期中選舉年初到大選持有正二，在 0050 的 3 個窗口裡和一直抱 0050 差不多，但最大回檔 −58% 對 −34%；從期中選舉當天才買則落後。用一半資金買正二只會重現 1 倍曝險：省下的資金要另有用途才有意義。3 個窗口無法分辨好壞。
